description: This file contains utility functions and interfaces for creating and managing event type groups, profiles with permissions, and related data structures in a project involving team and user event groups.

methods.name: createUserEventGroup
methods.description: Creates an event group object for a user profile, fetching the Booker URL and setting profile metadata.

methods.name: createTeamEventGroup
methods.description: Creates an event group object for a team, parsing team metadata and setting permissions and profile info.

methods.name: createProfilesWithPermissions
methods.description: Generates an array of profiles with permissions based on event groups and a permissions map.
